newsitem.title: USA: Etec sets 4.4 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Etec sets 4.4 mln shr offering.

text.p: Etec Systems Inc said Wednesday it plans to file a registration statement relating to a proposed public offering of 4,400,000 shares of its common stock.

The company said of the shares sold, 500,000 will be sold by the company and 3,900,000 will be sold by certain stockholders of the company. Etec will grant the underwriters an option to purchase an additional 660,000 shares to cover over-allotments, if any.

The net proceeds to the company from the offering are expected to be used for capital expenditures and for general corporate purposes including working capital. Etec will not receive any proceeds from the sale of the Common Stock offered by the selling stockholders.
